description: This file defines an interface called OutpostsArnInterface which extends the ArnInterface. It is part of the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically related to S3 Outposts ARNs.

classes.name: OutpostsArnInterface
classes.description: An interface to represent AWS S3 Outposts ARNs, extending the general ArnInterface and including a method to retrieve the Outpost ID.

methods.name: getOutpostId
methods.description: Method to retrieve the Outpost ID from the ARN.
